text: {"final": {"summary": "In register_household, captured whether the caller supplied an ID (supplied_id = record.get('id')) before the setdefault assigns one. Imported is_valid_household_id from core.ids and added a validation alongside the existing checks: if an ID was supplied and is not valid, raise ValueError(f\"invalid household id {household.id!r}\") before any append/save, so nothing is persisted on rejection. Auto-assigned IDs (no caller-supplied ID) are not validated, keeping that path working.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
